Title: Vinland Saga
Author: Makoto Yukimura
Review: Started reading after I finished Horimiya manga and moving off romance for a bit. Already watched the first 2 seasons but started from the beginning. The first season of the anime, while great does skip important parts of the story. It is obviously less gritty and doesn't include certain scenes which are understandable however this also gives a different impression of certain characters mainly Askellad and Canute. They are much better characters in the manga and Canutes transformation is better understood. Askellad is even better in the manga and definitely the main character. Season 2 of the anime is very well adapted so no complaints there. After the 2nd season the manga slowly but surely takes a different change of tone and incorporates more humour. This also happens as the art style takes another change. This works well in many areas and removes certain depressing tones but in other areas it feels more so like a shounen. The Vinland arc is amazing and very well executed. The best display of Thorfinns character especially with his relation to Hild. Einar's death was very well done and the manga had a great ending. Some may claim it was rushed but as someone not aware of any delays as I started reading after the manga finished, It felt well placed and avoided the curse of continuing for too long.
